rationale: DESeq2 Wald with ~condition on raw counts fits the 6v6 unpaired single-batch design, and the shallow sample is handled well: library size, size factor, Cook's, PCA/distance inspection, kept by default with an explicit leave-one-out sensitivity rather than silent removal. Size-factor normalization is stated inside the model. Weaknesses: the low-count prefilter has no stated threshold or justification; apeglm is listed as a package but LFC shrinkage is never stated as applied and BH is not named; the reference level is only implied by 'treated-vs-control'. Enrichment is strong (full Wald-stat ranking for fgsea, named Hallmark 2026.1 GMT, ORA universe explicitly restricted to tested genes) but lacks a stated set-size window; the report specifies versions and thresholds but not the counts of tested/significant genes.
